defenses: Production 2D VFX sprites for AshenSpire, faceted hand-painted dark fantasy. EXACTLY 24 distinct isolated sprites in 4 ROWS by 6 EQUAL COLUMNS on a wide 3:2 canvas. Six sequential frames per row: tiny anticipation, forming, opening, readable peak, dispersing, faint remnants. Real transparent alpha background. No checkerboard, solid background, characters, text, labels, actual equipment, scene or borders. Centered sprite within every cell, shared scale across each row. Each effect must occupy only central 60 percent of its cell, generous fully transparent gutters on ALL sides. Compact shapes, no tall beams or huge clouds crossing cell boundaries. Row1 PHYSICAL GUARD: short layered silver-gray plate-like energy chevrons forming a braced shield silhouette, faint blue edge, no physical shield. Row2 ARCANE WARD: indigo-violet geometric nested hexagonal ward, small crystalline points, hollow transparent center. Row3 MAGIC GUARD: pale cyan circular counterspell ring with a few white motes, airy hollow center, clearly different from angular arcane ward. Row4 BARRIER: low warm ivory-gold translucent protective dome over thin oval ground rim, no opaque fill, compact.
